info.title: Hiring Platform API
info.description: REST API for the franchise hiring platform. All store-nested routes require the `store.access` middleware (Bearer token + active user_store_access record). Non-store routes require authentication only.

perPage.name: per_page
perPage.description: Number of items per page. Must be 1–100.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Filter to users with access to this store

post.summary: Copy store configuration to another store

target_store_id.description: Must be different from source, must be accessible to user

stages.description: Optional inline stage creation. Exactly 1 must be is_initial=true. Positions and names must be unique.

post.summary: Apply to job opening (creates applicant + application)

email.description: At least email or phone required

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search applicant first_name, last_name, or email (LIKE)

parameters.name: job_opening_id
parameters.description: Must belong to this store, else 422

parameters.name: current_stage_id
parameters.description: Must belong to a workflow of this store, else 422

post.summary: Submit questionnaire answers for an application
Create document template (optionally with stage requirements)

requirements.description: Optional inline stage requirements. Stage IDs must belong to this store and must be unique in the array.

get.summary: List document requirements for a stage

post.description: Upload the applicant document file. Transitions status from pending to submitted.

file.description: Uploaded applicant document file. Allowed types: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, doc, docx. Max size: 10MB.
